prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Sign in with your primary account to automatically preserve and sync all your desktop pets across sessions."]
1: ["Tip: Right-click your pet on the desktop anytime to open quick controls or chat!"]
2: ["Mastering Your Desktop Companion", "Learn how to summon, move, and interact with your new pet right from your system tray.", "Quick Guide"]
3: ["Checking desktop display and graphics driver status..."]
4: ["Your Companion is Ready on Desktop!", "Check off these quick setup steps to get familiar with your pet's desktop presence.", "Locate pet icon in system tray"]
5: ["Estimated rendering time remaining:"]
6: ["Choose Your Pet Companion Journey", "Select whether to adopt a classic pet or build a custom desktop companion."]
7: ["For best generation results, upload clear, well-lit photos with your pet centered in the frame."]
8: ["If the sign-in window takes more than a few seconds to appear, click reload or check your browser permissions."]
9: ["Welcome Your Desktop Pet!", "Your pet is active on your screen. You can right-click its tray icon anytime to bring it to the front or customize behavior."]
